name: Blast Mine's Remote Detonation comes and goes without a chat line or a new button (#3965)
contract: AscensionTinker::Refresh teaches Remote Detonation 801798 with learnSpell(801798, true) while a Blast Mine 50045
is live and removes it with removeSpell(801798, SPEC_MASK_ALL, true) once no mine is left. The client printed
'You have learned a new spell' for every learn, placed it on another empty button up to level 10, and printed
'You have unlearned' for every removal. Extensions.dll skips the learn's lines while the spell's SpellCustomAttr
row carries the quiet-learn bit and its button placement while it carries the no-placement bit; the client skips
the removal's line while the spell's Spell row carries SPELL_ATTR0_DO_NOT_DISPLAY, and Extensions.dll leaves the
spell's buttons in place for a removal ending in a zero byte. Expected over two mines: the spell reaches the
client's spellbook each time, no line and no placement for any learn or removal, each removal keeps its buttons
and its Spell row is put back exactly afterwards, and an ordinary learn (Deploy Blast Mine) still prints its line.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Deploy Blast Mine
CONTROL: an ordinary learn still prints its line
SETUP: Remote Detonation is unknown before any mine exists
Deploy a mine 1 yd from the golem
SETUP: Remote Detonation is taught while the mine is live
The client is told about Remote Detonation
Learning it printed nothing
The learn places no button
Detonate the mine
SETUP: Remote Detonation leaves with the last mine
The client is told it is gone
The removal keeps its buttons
The removal printed nothing
Its row is put back exactly after the removal
The restored row is Remote Detonation's own
Deploy a second mine
SETUP: Remote Detonation is taught again
Still one Remote Detonation on the client
Zero lines for Remote Detonation over both mines
Neither learn placed a button
